answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops bulk fakes. Each agent forges one bond of 200 units, decaying 10 per epoch unless renewed by verified work: a quill-signed log of real jobs, checked against the agent's orchard of past tasks. Renewal restores only 5, so idle fakes fade in 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 plus 10,000 per epoch in decay, above any farming gain. An honest agent pays 200 once, renews cheaply, and keeps undiluted rewards.
